translations.web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
translations.bsb: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
translations.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
translations.asv: And see that thou make them after their pattern, which hath been showed thee in the mount.
